image_description: A close-up shot of a dessert plate featuring a slice of dark chocolate cake and two scoops of vanilla ice cream. The ice cream is topped with red berry sauce and sits next to the cake, which is drizzled with chocolate sauce. The plate has decorative swirls of chocolate and berry sauce. The background shows a colorful, patterned tablecloth.

The elliptical perspective of the plate rim is consistent, but the pattern on the tablecloth in the upper left shows slight warping/blurring that doesn't perfectly align with the depth of field, suggesting minor generative inconsistency in background geometry.
